questions.body_en:

1/1, 1/2, 2/2, 1/3, 2/3, 3/3, 1/4, 2/4, 3/4, 4/4, ...
questions.body_id:
Diketahui bahwa suku ke-2023 dalam barisan pecahan berikut adalah m/n, tentukan (m + n).

1/1, 1/2, 2/2, 1/3, 2/3, 3/3, 1/4, 2/4, 3/4, 4/4, ...

questions.body_en: There are 126 cartons of apples in a warehouse, each containing between 120 and 144 apples. What is the greatest number of cartons that is guaranteed to contain the same number of apples at any given time?
questions.body_id: Terdapat 126 karton apel di gudang, masing-masing berisi antara 120 hingga 144 apel. Berapa banyak karton terbesar yang dijamin berisi jumlah apel yang sama?

questions.body_en: A teacher took 51 pupils on a riverboat excursion. A big boat can take 6 passengers while a small boat can take 4. Given that a total of 11 boats were hired, how many small boats were there?
questions.body_id: Seorang guru membawa 51 murid dalam perjalanan perahu sungai. Perahu besar dapat menampung 6 penumpang sedangkan perahu kecil dapat menampung 4. Jika total 11 perahu disewa, berapa banyak perahu kecil?

questions.body_en: In the figure below, an equilateral triangle is inscribed in a circle. The circle is in turn inscribed in a bigger equilateral triangle. The ratio of the area of the small triangle to the big triangle is m : n. Find the value of (m + n).
questions.body_id: Pada gambar di bawah, sebuah segitiga sama sisi terdapat di dalam sebuah lingkaran. Lingkaran tersebut terdapat di dalam sebuah segitiga sama sisi yang lebih besar. Perbandingan luas segitiga kecil dengan segitiga besar adalah m : n. Tentukan nilai (m + n).

questions.body_en:
Mark and Nick were running, in the same direction, around a 400 m circular track at speeds of 200 m/min and 160 m/min, respectively. Given that they started at the same point, how many minutes will it take for them to meet again?

Leave your answer as a whole number with no units.
questions.body_id:
Mark dan Nick berlari searah mengelilingi lintasan melingkar 400 m dengan kecepatan masing-masing 200 m/menit dan 160 m/menit. Jika mereka memulai dari titik yang sama, berapa menit yang diperlukan agar mereka bertemu kembali?

Tuliskan jawabanmu sebagai bilangan bulat tanpa satuan.

questions.body_en:
The grass at the ranch grows at a constant rate every day. 27 oxen could finish eating the grass in 6 days, and 23 oxen could finish eating the grass in 9 days. For how many days could the ranch sustain a herd of 24 oxen?

Leave your answer as a whole number with no units.
questions.body_id:
Rumput di peternakan tumbuh dengan laju tetap setiap hari. 27 ekor sapi dapat menghabiskan rumput dalam 6 hari, dan 23 ekor sapi dapat menghabiskan rumput dalam 9 hari. Berapa hari peternakan tersebut dapat menghidupi 24 ekor sapi?

Tuliskan jawabanmu sebagai bilangan bulat tanpa satuan.
